stem.text: A goods train passes through a station at a steady speed of $10\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ at time $t = 0$. An express train is at rest at the station. The express train leaves the station with a uniform acceleration of $0.5\,\text{m s}^{-2}$ just as the goods train goes past. Both trains move in the same direction on straight, parallel tracks.
At which time $t$ does the express train overtake the goods train?
